steps.observation: You have 10 seconds. What are three strategies for reducing carbon emissions in cities?

steps.action:
• Clean energy switch: Install rooftop solar, wind-powered micro-grids and mandate renewable electricity for municipal facilities.

• Low-carbon mobility: Expand rapid public transit, protected bike lanes and EV-charging networks to pull commuters out of fossil-fuel cars.

• Efficient buildings: Retrofit insulation, high-performance windows and smart HVAC/lighting systems while enforcing strict efficiency codes for new construction.
